name: Hand-Drawn Animation: Location Exterior
description: Image preset for a location exterior in the Hand-Drawn Animation look.
system_prompt: Write one image prompt for an exterior establishing shot. Name the location's defining structure, surroundings, time of day, and weather from the entity, then apply the style.
context_prompt: wide exterior establishing view of the location, clear foreground, midground and background, a sense of scale from a figure or doorway, classic hand-drawn 2D animation cel, confident tapered ink line, simple rounded shapes built to move, flat colour with one soft shadow pass, gouache painted background, warm storybook palette, soft ambient light
negative_prompt: photorealistic, 3d render, anime, gritty texture, extra limbs, blurry, text, watermark
